description: Search a Help Center knowledge base by keyword. teamId, slug, and query are all optional except query — with no teamId or slug, the first team that has a configured Help Center slug is used.

slug.description: Help Center slug (public identifier). Overrides teamId-based resolution.

teamId.description: Team ID — resolves to the Help Center slug via the team's KB settings. Use list_teams to find your team ID.

name: search_knowledge
title: Search the knowledge base
